_doc: Cast + contact verb taxonomies. Two 2D matrices pinned from design_thoughts.txt:598-600. Cast = trajectory × effect. Contact = verb × (optional held object). Identifiers-only scaffold — no gameplay tuning (damage/force/palette) until renderer consumes them. Brain reads via core/systems/verbs.py. Godot will consume via manifest when cast/contact rendering lands.

cast_trajectories._doc: How a cast reaches its target. Determines travel curve, speed band, and whether the player can lead or dodge it.

cast_effects._doc: The payload delivered on contact. Grouped by element family so palettes + reactions can resolve by family when specifics are unknown.

contact_verbs._doc: Avatar-initiated physical contact without a held object. Resolved brain-side off the same proximity trigger that fires deposit_intent. Intensity band is coarse placement for the renderer to map to contact VFX.

held_object_verbs._doc: Contact verbs that require a held object. Object kind (from kind_config weapons) crosses with verb to produce final flavor. Renderer picks an animation; brain picks a narration line.
